source: Project Operating System Phase 4 - Validation Engine
name: Validation Contract
objective: Define future validation responsibilities for compliance with platform standards without executing validation or changing production behavior.
scope: calculator visual render and responsive evidence resolution
calculator institutional theme and governed visible freshness
editorial depth and permanent content visibility
canonical recommendation slot and adaptive report compliance
article search intent and editorial clarity
article freshness source traceability and change impact
article cluster position bidirectional links orphan risk and anchors
expectedOutputs: adaptive report contract and render gate results
notes: This contract defines the Validation Engine protocol but does not execute validations.
Validation complements Testing by checking compliance with official project standards.
For NEW_ASSET and MIGRATED_ASSET calculators, static validation cannot be reported as visual PASS.
VISUAL_VALIDATION_NOT_EXECUTED blocks FULL_STANDARD_ACCEPTED until rendered evidence or resolved manual visual approval exists.
For NEW_ARTICLE and MIGRATED_ARTICLE, all seven article gates are required before publication.
For LEGACY_ARTICLE, return LEGACY_ACCEPTED_PENDING_MIGRATION unless a migration is explicitly in scope.
